items.title: Fred Staton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 12, 2008
items.q: He counts Coleman Hawkins and Chu Berry as influences on his own style

ctx.x: Tenor saxophonist Fred Staton was born on February 14, 1915 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. He counts Coleman Hawkins and Chu Berry as influences on his own style, and his playing experiences range from a brief but arduous tour with a carnival group to touring the Scandinavian countries with his sister, the late vocalist Dakota Staton. Fred continues to perform with The Harlem Blues and Jazz Band.
Fred was interviewed in Clinton, New York on April 12, 2008 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
